# criblio_search_datatypes (Data Source)

Returns all matching objects in `items`, following API pagination automatically. Scope the request using the required attributes below. An empty collection returns an empty list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "criblio_search_datatypes" "example" {
}
```

## Schema

### Read-Only

- `items` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Read-Only:

- `add_fields` (Attributes List) Computed fields to add to each event. Each entry specifies a field name and a source expression. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--add_fields))
- `additional_extractions` (Attributes List) Additional extractions applied after the primary extraction. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--additional_extractions))
- `automatic_extraction` (Attributes) JSON extraction configuration applied to each newline-delimited JSON event. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--automatic_extraction))
- `description` (String) Brief description of the Datatype.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the Datatype.
- `lib` (String) Library scope for the Datatype. Value is <code>custom</code> for user-defined Datatypes or <code>cribl</code> for built-in Datatypes.
- `local_search` (Attributes) Configuration for lakehouse engine, such as auto-detection expressions. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--local_search))
- `max_event_bytes` (Integer) Maximum event size before truncation, in bytes.
- `min_raw_length` (Integer) Minimum raw event length used when identifying the Datatype.
- `schema_map` (Attributes List) Field mappings to rename or alias extracted fields, retained for compatibility with earlier configurations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--schema_map))
- `schema_maps` (Attributes) Out-of-box schema mappings keyed by target schema type. Applied at ingest when enabled by a dataset rule. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--schema_maps))
- `search_version` (String) Search execution version used by the Datatype.
- `should_use_data_raw` (Boolean) If <code>true</code>, applies v1-style nested <code>_raw</code> JSON semantics for Cribl Lake Search v2 Datasets.
- `tags` (String) Comma-separated tags for the Datatype.
- `timestamp_extraction` (Attributes) Timestamp extraction rules applied after all extractions complete. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--timestamp_extraction))

<a id="nestedatt--items--add_fields"></a>
<a id="nestedatt--items--schema_map"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.add_fields`

Read-Only:

- `field_name` (String) Target field name to populate.
- `source` (String) Kusto expression or field name that provides the value.

<a id="nestedatt--items--additional_extractions"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.additional_extractions`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the additional extraction.
- `source_field` (String) Field to use as input for the extraction.
- `contains_header_row` (Boolean) Indicates that the source file contains a header row.
- `delimiter` (String) Field delimiter that separates columns in delimited text.
- `escape` (String) Escape character for embedded quotes or special characters.
- `field_list` (List of String) Optional list of fields to extract.
- `null_value` (String) Value substituted when a column is empty or null.
- `quote` (String) Quote character used to wrap fields that contain the delimiter.

### Nested Schema for `items.automatic_extraction`

### Nested Schema for `items.local_search`

Read-Only:

- `datagen_sample_id` (String) Sample ID from <code>samples.yml</code> used with datagen for event generation.
- `fuzzkit_generator` (Attributes) Explicit FuzzKit generator linkage, overriding inference from the Datatype ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--local_search--fuzzkit_generator))
- `kusto_expression` (String) Kusto expression used to auto-detect the Datatype. Present when the Datatype participates in auto-detection.

Read-Only:

- `log_type` (String) Log type for the FuzzKit generator.
- `vendor` (String) Vendor name for the FuzzKit generator.

<a id="nestedatt--items--schema_maps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.schema_maps`

Read-Only:

- `ocsf_v1_8` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items--schema_maps--ocsf_v1_8))

<a id="nestedatt--items--schema_maps--ocsf_v1_8"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.schema_maps.ocsf_v1_8`

Read-Only:

- `field_name` (String) Field Name
- `source` (String) Kusto expression that denotes the value of the field. May be a simple field name or a more complex expression for a computed value.

<a id="nestedatt--items--timestamp_extraction"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items.timestamp_extraction`

Read-Only:

- `anchor_regex` (String) Regular expression that restricts where the timestamp parser scans within <code>sourceField</code>.
- `earliest` (String) Earliest allowed timestamp as a relative time string. Older parsed timestamps are clamped.
- `latest` (String) Latest allowed timestamp as a relative time string. Newer parsed timestamps are clamped.
- `source_field` (String) Event field to scan for timestamps. If omitted, the entire event payload is scanned.
- `timezone` (String) Default timezone applied when parsed timestamps do not include a timezone offset.
- `scan_depth` (Integer) Number of characters to scan beyond the anchor before falling back to the current time.
